verdicts.decision_note: The reported mismatch establishes the implementation-relevant accuracy rule that the BigQuery-backed gross-sales figure must match its source figure.
First concrete failure: testing showed that the BigQuery gross-sales figure did not match the source figure.

The client establishes the selected date range as an implementation-relevant condition for accurately comparing the dashboard gross-sales figures; replacing the existing accuracy_rule leaves no stale key.
First concrete verification after the apparent failure: the client confirms that the figures match when the applicable date range is selected.
